title: PacketcraftR output common primitives v1
description: Shared envelope, error, scalar, and evidence definitions used by the command payload schemas.

seq.description: Zero-based ordinal of this emitted NDJSON record within one command invocation. Records are contiguous, and domain identifiers remain in result or error context.

event.description: Stream record discriminator; complete and error terminate the stream.

payload_schema.description: Command payload schema identifier; present on every success envelope.

capture_settings.description: Native driver-buffer and timestamp settings this source realized; absent when the backend reported none. effective null means unreported, never zero or default.

captureStatistics.description: Capture-provider counters reported by the backend; these can differ from command-processed counters when filtering, queueing, or provider loss occurs.

ipAddress.description: Validators must enable JSON Schema format assertions to enforce IP address syntax.

ipDatagramKey.description: Capture-scoped identity of one fragmented IPv4 or IPv6 datagram.

ipReassemblyReport.description: Capture-global fragment counters and bounded completed or incomplete datagram outcomes.

operationStats.description: Command-processed counters. Capture counts admitted frames as packets_attempted, confirmed consumer deliveries as packets_completed, and admitted captured bytes as bytes; sources separately report delivery and loss. Backend counters remain distinct.

realizedBytes.description: Requested/applied/effective triple for a byte-valued native setting; effective null means the backend cannot report the realized value.

scanStage.description: Discovery probes come first and share one sequence space with the scan probes after them.

scope.description: A declared zone and the interface identity it resolved to; present only on scoped targets.

sctpScan.description: The effective SCTP chunk a raw scan sends to SCTP scan endpoints.

sourceFrame.description: One-based source-frame identity supplied to display filters as frame.number; filtering does not renumber it.

tcpFlags.description: TCP flag bits within the nine defined bits (FIN=1, SYN=2, RST=4, PSH=8, ACK=16, URG=32, ECE=64, CWR=128, NS=256).

tcpScan.description: The effective TCP segment a raw scan sends to TCP scan endpoints. Diagnostic modes are stack-dependent heuristics; custom is observation-only and infers no port state.
